name: Meghalaya State Data Centre (MSDC), NIC Building, Shillong
developer: Department of IT & C, Government of Meghalaya / Meghalaya Information Technology Society
notes: Official DIT page (live, re-verified 2026-08-12): MSDC inaugurated 17 Aug 2011, ~1,800 sq ft on 2nd floor of NIC Building, Shillong (East Khasi Hills); ISO/IEC 20000:2011 and 27001:2013 certified; connected to MSWAN; hosts 32+ state e-governance applications; DR replication to NIC National Data Centre New Delhi. NIC informatics news (2012) and IPinfo ASN148859 corroborate the facility.

name: New Meghalaya State Data Centre at ICCC Building, Umsawli, New Shillong
developer: Department of IT & C, Government of Meghalaya / Meghalaya Information Technology Society
notes: New MSDC build-out at the ICCC (Integrated Command & Control Centre) building, Umsawli, New Shillong Township. Active 2025 procurement: RFP for BMS/access-control/CCTV for MSDC (deadline 13 Nov 2025, updated 29 Oct 2025) and corrigendum RFP for new MSDC; TCIL EOI references client tender MITS/2025/2-B. ICCC building itself was inaugurated Nov 2024 as the Smart City Shillong command centre (ET report), so the data-centre fit-out is still in tender stage; tender documents mention 120 kVA UPS and 250 kVA DG set, no MW capacity disclosed.
Byrnihat EPIP industrial belt (Ri-Bhoi) checked for datacenter activity; only industrial/air-quality references found, no datacenter project.
Tura IT Park coverage concerns digital connectivity/incubation, not a datacenter facility.

name: Mizoram State Data Centre, Treasury Square, Aizawl
developer: Government of Mizoram Department of ICT / NIC Mizoram
notes: NIC Mizoram State Centre (Annex-II Mizoram Secretariat, Treasury Square, Aizawl) hosts the state data centre providing secure infrastructure for e-governance; official DICT page documents the State Data Centre. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Mizoram State Data Center & Cloud enablement upgrade (SASCI 2022-23)
developer: Government of Mizoram DICT / Ministry of Finance (SASCI)
notes: Official proceedings: Mizoram e-services portal and upgradation of Mizoram State Data Center & Cloud enablement project under Part-IV SASCI 2022-23 approved at Rs 22.50 crore by the Ministry of Finance. Placed in Aizawl as the existing SDC is at Treasury Square, Aizawl; power capacity not disclosed.

name: HybridInternet Champhai data center upgrade
notes: Search-indexed Instagram post claims upgrading a data center in Champhai; no official or trade-press confirmation found. Unverified local ISP server-room lead, not a confirmed colocation facility.
